title: Primordial Spell Core
text: Spell cores power arcane industry. The primordial core provides a mana engine with 512 su of base capacity.

Place a crude light core in the assembly table center. Add one each of the earth, water, fire and air microcores in any outer positions, or use a single analysis crystal instead. Forging consumes the entire analysis crystal.
Equipping it in the spell core slot grants 15% spell power, 20% mana regeneration speed and 200 maximum mana.
Spell cores can be placed on solid ground and recovered by breaking them. Only the first equipped core grants bonuses; removing it promotes the next one. Multiple cores never stack their bonuses.
